Oman National Day holiday countdown

Shows the days and hours until the National Day holiday starts, in Muscat time, and marks the holiday while it is under way.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-26

The 2026 National Day holiday is on Wednesday 25 and Thursday 26 November, according to the Ministry of Labour statement of the 2026 holiday dates (Arabic), confirmed by Times of Oman on 22 October 2026. That statement did not set the 2027 holiday, so after the 2026 holiday the countdown below runs in Muscat time to the days of Royal Decree 15/2025, Saturday 20 and Sunday 21 November 2027 (expected), and marks the holiday while it is under way.

How many days left?

About Oman National Day

Oman's National Day is 20 and 21 November under Royal Decree 15/2025, which amended Royal Decree 88/2022 determining the official holidays. In 2026, 20 November fell on a Friday, and the official holiday was moved to Wednesday 25 and Thursday 26 November in the 2026 holiday dates the Ministry of Labour announced in advance on 28 December 2025.

Frequently asked questions

When is the Oman National Day holiday in 2026?

Wednesday 25 and Thursday 26 November 2026, according to the Ministry of Labour's statement of the 2026 holiday dates (Oman Daily, 28 December 2025). National Day itself is 20 and 21 November under Royal Decree 15/2025.

When is the Oman National Day holiday in 2027?

The Ministry of Labour's statement of the 2026 holiday dates did not set it. National Day is 20 and 21 November under Royal Decree 15/2025, a Saturday and a Sunday in 2027, so the countdown runs to those days, marked as expected, until the official holiday is announced.

Is the National Day holiday for the private sector in Oman?

Yes, official holidays are paid for workers under the Labour Law; working on them earns extra pay.
